assertions.title: Scrutiny phases auto-inject at milestone completion

steps.expected: Tests in 'VAL-EXEC-001: scrutiny phase auto-injection' describe block pass
steps.observed: 2 tests pass: 'creates a scrutiny validation phase when milestone completes' and 'scrutiny phase is first in the injection order'

steps.expected: Tests in 'VAL-EXEC-001/002: auto-injection at milestone completion' describe block pass
steps.observed: 2 tests pass: 'injects scrutiny and behavioral validation phases when milestone completes' (verifies 4 phases total = 2 original + 2 injected) and 'injected phases run between milestone and next milestone phases' (verifies 7 phases for 3 original across 2 milestones)

steps.expected: Tests verify scrutiny phase is created with 'Scrutiny: <milestone>' title, pending status, correct milestone association, and is first in injection order
steps.observed: Tests confirm: createValidationPhases('auth', 0) returns phases where first is 'Scrutiny: auth' with status 'pending' and milestone 'auth'. ExecutionLoop integration confirms 4 spawner calls (2 impl + 2 validation) when 2-phase M1 milestone completes

steps.expected: Tests in 'VAL-EXEC-002: behavioral validation phase auto-injection' describe block pass
steps.observed: 2 tests pass: 'creates a behavioral validation phase when milestone completes' and 'behavioral validation phase comes after scrutiny'

steps.expected: Execution loop integration tests confirm behavioral phase is injected after scrutiny
steps.observed: Test 'injects scrutiny and behavioral validation phases when milestone completes' verifies 4 total phases (2 impl + scrutiny + behavioral). Log output confirms: phaseNames=["Scrutiny: M1","Validation: M1"]

steps.expected: Tests verify behavioral phase is created with 'Validation: <milestone>' title, pending status, and comes after scrutiny
steps.observed: Tests confirm: createValidationPhases returns phases[1] as 'Validation: auth' with status 'pending', milestone 'auth'. phases.length == 2 with scrutiny at index 0 and behavioral at index 1

steps.expected: Tests in 'VAL-EXEC-008: skip flags' describe block pass
steps.observed: 4 tests pass: 'skip_scrutiny prevents scrutiny phase injection' (1 phase: Validation only), 'skip_validation prevents behavioral validation phase injection' (1 phase: Scrutiny only), 'both skip flags prevent all validation phase injection' (0 phases), 'skip flags are independent — can skip one but not the other'

steps.expected: Execution loop integration tests confirm skip flags work end-to-end
steps.observed: 3 tests pass: 'skip_scrutiny prevents scrutiny phase injection' (3 spawner calls = 2 impl + 1 behavioral), 'skip_validation prevents behavioral validation phase injection' (3 calls = 2 impl + 1 scrutiny), 'both skip flags prevent all validation injection' (2 calls = only impl)

steps.expected: skip_scrutiny and skip_validation config flags are read and passed through
steps.observed: ExecutionLoop reads config.skip_scrutiny and config.skip_validation, passes them to createValidationPhases as {skipScrutiny, skipValidation}. MilestoneTracker.createValidationPhases conditionally omits scrutiny/behavioral phases based on these flags

steps.expected: Tests in 'VAL-EXEC-009: validation phase metadata' describe block pass
steps.observed: 5 tests pass: 'scrutiny phase has descriptive name with milestone' (title 'Scrutiny: checkout-flow'), 'behavioral phase has descriptive name with milestone' (title 'Validation: checkout-flow'), 'phases have appropriate descriptions' (descriptions contain 'Scrutiny validation' / 'Behavioral validation' + milestone name), 'phases have step checklists' (steps array non-empty), 'phases are assigned sequential indices from startIndex' (indices 10 and 11 from startIndex=10)

steps.expected: Phase names follow 'Scrutiny: <milestone>' / 'Validation: <milestone>' pattern, have descriptions, steps, and sequential indices
steps.observed: All metadata properties verified: title includes milestone name, description references validation type and milestone, steps array has >0 items, indices are sequential from startIndex. Phases are distinguishable from implementation phases via isValidation=true flag and naming convention

steps.expected: Tests in 'VAL-EXEC-012: injection preserves ordering' describe block pass
steps.observed: 2 tests pass: 'checkAndCreateValidationPhases returns phases in correct order' (scrutiny before behavioral, correct milestone association) and 'multiple milestones produce independent injections' (separate injection objects per milestone)

steps.expected: Execution loop integration test confirms ordering preserved end-to-end
steps.observed: Test 'validation phases are injected before remaining pending phases' passes — with M1 (1 phase) and M2 (1 phase), after M1 completes, validation is injected before M2's pending phase. Total 6 spawner calls = 2 impl + 2 M1 val + 2 M2 val. Log output confirms injection order: 'Scrutiny: M1' then 'Validation: M1' injected before M2 phase executes

steps.expected: Injection prepends validation phases at top of remaining queue without reordering existing pending phases
steps.observed: Test confirms: after M1's single phase completes, 2 validation phases are injected, then M2's original phase runs next (maintaining its position). Multiple milestone test shows M1 and M2 validations each injected independently with phases array preserved in order

assertions.title: Skip flags propagate through entire chain

steps.expected: Tests in 'VAL-CROSS-007: skip flags propagation' describe block pass
steps.observed: 3 tests pass: 'skip_scrutiny prevents scrutiny injection but allows behavioral' (1 phase: 'Validation: M1'), 'skip_validation prevents behavioral injection but allows scrutiny' (1 phase: 'Scrutiny: M1'), 'both skipped marks milestone as sealed with no phases' (0 injections, milestone still sealed)

steps.expected: Execution loop integration tests confirm skip flags propagate through entire pipeline chain
steps.observed: 3 skip-flag tests pass in execution loop: skip_scrutiny → only behavioral injected (3 spawner calls), skip_validation → only scrutiny injected (3 spawner calls), both → no validation injected (2 spawner calls). Flags propagate from config through ExecutionLoop to MilestoneTracker.createValidationPhases

steps.expected: skip_scrutiny and skip_validation are independent — each only affects its own validation type
steps.observed: Confirmed: skip_scrutiny=true only removes scrutiny phases, behavioral still injected. skip_validation=true only removes behavioral phases, scrutiny still injected. Both flags can be set independently with no interaction

summary: Tested 6 assertions: 6 passed, 0 failed. All 57 tests (46 in milestone-tracker.test.ts + 11 in execution-loop-milestone-injection.test.ts) pass with 0 failures. Tests comprehensively cover scrutiny auto-injection (VAL-EXEC-001), behavioral validation auto-injection (VAL-EXEC-002), skip flags bypass (VAL-EXEC-008), validation phase metadata (VAL-EXEC-009), injection ordering preservation (VAL-EXEC-012), and skip flag propagation through the chain (VAL-CROSS-007).
